findings.reason: U+202F followed by U+0020 leaves a two-character gap before the colon. The fr guide requires a single espace fine insécable before ':', and the rest of the fr locale agrees: 249 occurrences (219 distinct values) use U+202F immediately before the colon and zero use the U+202F+space+colon pattern. Fixing spend_label also brings its rendered width to 40, exactly at its maxCells.
findings.reason_short: double spacing before the colon (U+202F + U+0020)

findings.reason: The liveness line describes the session (la session): the same slot renders 'Terminée' (feminine), 'En attente de vous' and 'Ne répond pas'. 'Inactif' is the only masculine form in the set, so the gender flips between states. Making the whole set masculine ('Terminé') is the alternative, but 'Session terminée'/'Terminée' is the established fr rendering.

safety_copy.approve: PASS — pill 'Approuver'; accessible name starts with 'Approuver' (sidecar requirement) and 'une demande attend votre réponse' matches the existing relay.approvals wording 'Cette demande attend toujours votre réponse.'; no implication that approval is automatic or already given.
safety_copy.ended_resume: PASS — 'Session terminée · historique conservé' (ended, history kept) and 'Un envoi ou Reprendre la rouvre dans votre dossier personnel' (a send or Resume reopens it, in the home folder, not the project folder) preserve the English semantics; 'Reprendre' matches relay.chrome.session.resume and fr CLI usage. Only typography nit F03.
safety_copy.degraded: PASS — 'Ne répond pas — les envois attendront' matches 'messages typed now are kept and delivered when it answers again'; consistent with subtitle.not_answering 'Ne répond pas'.

observations_accepted: link.since_*: 'synchro' is an idiomatic French clipping of synchronisation; 'dernière synchro' would be 49 cells > maxCells 44, so the short form is justified. Meaning ('synced # seconds ago') is preserved.
list.no_matches: 'Aucun résultat' generalises 'No matching conversations', the standard French search empty state; no ambiguity in a search field.
list.filter.needs_you: 'À traiter' is a compact idiomatic rendering of 'Needs you'; the chip's accessible group label carries the 'conversations' context.
list.new: 'Nouvelle' is an elliptical label agreeing with 'Nouvelle session' (the accessible name); the 10-cell budget excludes the noun.
appearance.on/off: 'Oui'/'Non' rather than 'Activé'/'Désactivé' because 'Désactivé' is 9 > maxCells 6; the value answers the toggle's label naturally.

Glossary check: session→session, project→projet, usage→utilisation, cost→coût (spend rendered as 'dépenses' here), job/task→tâche, settings→paramètres, appearance→apparence, library→bibliothèque, agent→agent; the kept-English set is respected (Local Operator, tags; no tool-name prose in this namespace). No drift between the chrome strings and the existing fr catalogues.
limitations: No rendered app/browser evidence in this pass; rendered evidence is explicitly deferred and not claimed here. Width findings are cell-count signals against the en sidecar maxCells and the in-house renderer, not pixel proof.
The repo catalogue gate does not enforce the full CLDR category set for plurals that are already plurals in en; the fr many category was therefore verified manually (present in all four plural keys).
The unit-test failure is a slice-integration expectation (namespace snapshot not yet updated for relay.chrome), not an fr translation defect; it was observed, not fixed.
